thread:
maria-finance: Heads-up 10K embed units dispute from OrbitWorks (O-778). They say their telemetry shows no surge on 2026-08-09 11:20Z but invoice jumped.
dave-platops: Quick look: gateway traces show an upstream proxy flapping and clients re-sending identical payloads while generating new request_ids. Our ledger keys on request_id so retries look billable.
anya-billing: Can you run a short dedupe count and give a USD estimate? I have sign-off up to $5k.
dave-platops: Running quick query: ```SELECT client_payload_hash, count(*) as c, sum(embedding_units) as units FROM embed_raw WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-08-09T11:15:00Z' AND '2026-08-09T11:25:00Z' GROUP BY client_payload_hash HAVING count(*) > 1;```
ops-bot: quick-result: duplicate_rows=34, duplicated_units=101234, est_usd=1012.34 (prelim). CSV export: https://internal.storage/exports/O-778-dup.csv
sam-sales: CSM wants to tell the customer today. Recommend provisional credit and run audit-only backfill.
maria-finance: Proposal: issue provisional credit $1,013.00 (round up) and run BF-20260809-orbit-dedupe to validate. If the backfill changes numbers, we'll adjust with an adjustment memo.
anya-billing: Approved. anya-billing approves provisional credit $1,013.00 to OrbitWorks (O-778). Please attach CSV and job id.
dave-platops: Backfill job created BF-20260809-orbit-dedupe (audit-only). Runbook RB-dedupe-009. Canary 1% then full. Estimate 3h including verification. Will produce diff report before any ledger mutation.
sam-sales: Notifying CSM & OrbitWorks: "We've issued a provisional credit of $1,013.00 while we run an internal dedupe reconciliation. Expect final confirmation within 48h." :thumbsup:
maria-finance: Once GL posts, tag me and I'll close the dispute. Also open a router PR to emit dedupe_key and log client_payload_hash consistently.
ops-bot: PR link: https://git.internal/r/router/emit-dedupe-key. Job scheduled: https://jobs.internal/BF-20260809-orbit-dedupe status=scheduled
anya-billing: When backfill completes, post final ledger delta and checksum CSV so accounting can finalize the memo. Thanks.
